mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent consumer demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent supply-side strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent accommodative policy effects.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also decline, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS declines
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with a decline in Capacity Utilization signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of INDPRO and CAPUTL does not correlate with subsequent supply-side constraints.
